settings.description: The byte ladder re-run with this round's findings applied: luma precision chosen per budget (3 b below 20 B, 4 b to 56 B, 5 b above), chroma one bit below luma, plus the two encoder-only levers and aniso=1.2 selection weighting. The round-1 recipe had no sel_hv, so every tuned arm pins sel_hv=0: an arm that omitted it inherited the adopted 0.15 and measured the round-2 recipe instead. The pre-adoption arms are the baseline the tuned rows are compared against (EXPERIMENTS.md SS4.5, SS7.12): the v0.6-derived format resized to each budget exactly as budget-ladder.json resizes it (26:9 at L 5 b / chroma 4 b, the upper-tier raster from 108 B), with the four selection/encoder knobs pinned off. budget-ladder.json itself resizes the layout but inherits the adopted knobs, so it is the ladder of the format that ships, not of the one round 1 compared against.
